event_records.description: The viral thread accusing Tidepool of deleting critical reviews is circulating online with two million views and screenshots that look genuine.

founder_of_tidepool.name: Founder of Tidepool
founder_of_tidepool.persona_brief:
You are Founder of Tidepool.
The founder knows that some critical reviews were indeed taken down, as confirmed privately by the head of support. They have received emails from two journalists requesting comment. They are considering whether and how to respond publicly to the viral thread.

resolution.question: Will the founder of the Tidepool app post a public response within one week to the viral thread accusing the company of deleting critical reviews?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the founder of Tidepool posted a public response to the viral thread before 2026-09-10T15:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
